summary: Arabidopsis 3D wall-stained embryo stacks (Recherche Data Gouv, ~100 embryos, stages 1C to ~256C) and Cambridge shoot-meristem confocal, segmentation and lineage data (6 meristems) hold fixed or lineage-linked cell geometry from which shape before division and daughter wall can be read. Neither is a moss, liverwort, fern or algal apical-cell series, and neither supplies growth rate and interdivision time per cell in the record metadata I saw.
next_step: Open the Cambridge record's file list and the IDR idr0032 study to confirm time points and lineage fields; decide whether Arabidopsis cells are an acceptable proxy; compile a separate apical-cell series for a moss or fern from the literature for the stated scope.
obstacles_confirmed: Suitable apical-cell series for mosses, liverworts, ferns, and algae are not in the repositories searched.
Open image sets do not carry per-cell growth rates and division intervals together with wall orientation.
